turns.content: I need a LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X100VI targeting professional photographers. It should be concise, no more than 150 words, maintain a professional tone, and include a call to action. The post must highlight its 26.1MP sensor, hybrid autofocus system, and film simulation modes.

I created the draft and validated it against the confirmed product facts and requested constraints.

Introducing the Fujifilm X100VI, a powerhouse designed for professional photographers seeking exceptional image quality and versatility. Equipped with a 26.1MP sensor, this camera captures stunning details and vibrant colors, ensuring your photographs stand out in any portfolio. The X100VI features a cutting-edge hybrid autofocus system that combines phase detection and contrast detection, delivering fast and accurate focusing in various shooting conditions. This allows photographers to capture fleeting moments with precision, making it an ideal companion for street photography and portraiture alike. Additionally, the camera includes an array of film simulation modes, allowing users to recreate the look and feel of classic film stocks. This feature enhances creativity and provides photographers with the tools to express their unique style. Explore the Fujifilm X100VI and elevate your photography to new heights.
